name: amanda-ecommerce
description: Plataforma e-commerce + gestión de mercadería para Amanda Home & Deco

scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/server && npm run test -w packages/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/server && npm run lint -w packages/client
